This directly contradicts the bullish evidence [E8] and [E9], where ROE benchmarks are provided at 2.78% and 6.43%, respectively, indicating that BAIDFIN's actual ROE is significantly lower than its sector benchmark. Furthermore, [E27], [E28], and [E29] provide median return on equity (ROE) data over different time frames: the last year at 7%, the last three years at 7.3%, and the last five years at 7%. These figures further support the bear case, as they consistently show BAIDFIN's ROE below its sector benchmark. Given these strong indicators of a low return on equity, it is evident that the valuation evidence does not support the current market price of ₹155 Cr. The company's actual performance in terms of ROE is significantly lower than what would be expected based on its sector benchmarks, suggesting that the stock may be overvalued or even undervalued compared to its peers.
